style: The palette of the first image stays exactly as it is: cream stone, orange roofs, green grass, yellow sand, blue sea, dark timber, bronze and iron cannons. Flat colours, no textures, no people, no text, no watermark. The first attached image is the frame to redraw. The second attached image shows only the amount of detail per building to match, take nothing else from it, not its colours, not its camera, not its buildings, not its interface. Keep the camera, the composition, the tile grid and every object of the first image in its place.

frames.chunky: Redraw the first image at the {name} level of detail in a rounded and chunky shape language: every block has a fat bevel on every edge, about a tenth of the block's width, every corner is rounded, the roofs are thick slabs, the teeth of the battlements are rounded, the trees are round blobs on short trunks, the rocks are smooth rounded pebbles, like painted wooden toy blocks. Detail level: {detail} {style}
frames.sharp: Redraw the first image at the {name} level of detail in a faceted and sharp shape language: every edge is hard with no bevel, every corner is a crisp right angle, the roofs are thin planes, the teeth of the battlements are square, the trees are made of flat triangular facets, the rocks are angular with flat faces, a low-poly look with visible flat faces everywhere. Detail level: {detail} {style}

directions.name: Kingdoms and Castles
directions.detail: every house is one block with one plain roof and nothing on it but one dark square window, the walls are plain slabs with a row of square teeth along the top and no stones drawn, the towers are one block with a roof and a flag, no timber frames, no chimneys, no roof tiles drawn, no crates or barrels on the ground, the cannons are one barrel on one block. Three parts per building.

directions.name: River Towns
directions.detail: every house is one block with a roof and one or two features, a door, a row of two windows, one chimney, the walls have a walkway behind the row of teeth and a shallow ledge at their base and no stones drawn, the towers have a roof, a flag and one window, a few crates and barrels on the ground, the cannons are a barrel on a two-wheel carriage. Five to eight parts per building.

directions.name: Foundation
directions.detail: timber framing on the houses, the roofs with rows of tiles drawn as ridges, window frames with shutters, chimneys, the walls with a course of larger stones at the base and individual merlons with arrow slits along the top, the towers with a balcony, a window row and a flag, props on the ground, crates, barrels, a cart, a well, the cannons with a carriage, spoked wheels and a stack of balls. Twelve to twenty parts per building.
